dz: 图图什是塞尔柱克苏丹马利克·沙阿的弟弟,在阿因萨尔姆战役中击败了安纳托利亚的土耳其统治者苏莱曼·伊本·克塔尔米什.
de: Tutush, brother of Seljuk sultan Malik Shah, defeats Suleiman ibn Qutalmish, the Turkish ruler of Anatolia in the battle of Ain Salm.

t: 在萨格拉哈斯战役中，穆拉比特王朝击败卡斯蒂利亚人，却未能扩大战果。
te: At the Battle of Sagrajas, the Almoravids defeat the Castilians, but are unable to take advantage of their victory.
dz: 西班牙收复失地运动：在萨格拉哈斯战役中，穆拉比特王朝击败卡斯蒂利亚人，却未能扩大战果。
de: Spanish Reconquista: At the Battle of Sagrajas, the Almoravids defeat the Castilians, but are unable to take advantage of their victory.
